name: Step 1 & 2: Buyer Opens Product Page
expected: Product details loaded with title, price, and Add to Cart action

name: Step 3: Add Product to Cart
expected: Item added to persistent cart; counter incremented in navbar
actual: Product added to cart context successfully

name: Step 4: Update Cart Quantity
expected: Quantity increases and subtotal dynamically updates

name: Step 5: Proceed to Checkout
expected: Navigates to dedicated checkout page with order overview and shipping form

name: Step 6 & 7: Stripe Session Creation & Secure Redirection
expected: Creates server-authoritative Stripe Checkout Session with locked database reservation

name: Step 8: Backend Authoritative Payment Verification Guard
expected: Rejects forged client paymentStatus='paid'; forces status to pending or 401 without auth token
actual: Direct unverified POST /api/orders responded with status 401 (Protection Active)

name: Step 9: Payment Cancellation Handling
expected: Displays cancellation notification and keeps order in unfulfilled state without creating phantom orders

name: Step 10: Refresh During Checkout Resilience
expected: Page state and order items remain stable across browser reload during checkout
actual: Checkout UI and forms rendered stably after full browser reload

name: Step 11: Repeated Success-Page Visits
expected: Visiting or refreshing receipt page does not trigger duplicate order placement or mutations

name: Step 12: Invalid Payment Session Security
expected: Does not blindly mark order as paid on forged query parameter
actual: Handled safely without unauthorized database order mutation

name: Step 13: Webhook Cryptographic Verification
expected: Strictly rejects unsigned webhook deliveries (requires valid stripe-signature header)
actual: Webhook without signature returned HTTP 400 (Signature verification enforced)
